exceptions.justification: Transitive via licensee's own dependency-resolution internals (npm's arborist/pacote/sigstore stack, needed for REGISTRY package-fetch/verify operations). This package's own use of licensee only reads local node_modules license metadata already on disk (`licensee --production --errors-only --ndjson` against an installed tree); the registry-fetch code path that would actually exercise arborist never runs.
exceptions.alternatives: A pinned older licensee (8.2.0, via npm audit fix --force) avoids this specific arborist range but is an unverified major downgrade with its own CLI/flag-parsing differences (already hit one docopt-parsing incompatibility with the current licensee major line during this repo's own setup).
exceptions.remediation: Revisit when licensee ships a patched release in its current major line, or when a verified upgrade path to licensee 12.x lands.

exceptions.justification: Transitive via minimatch, pulled in by four independent dev-tool chains (crap4ts -> ts-morph -> @ts-morph/common, @microsoft/api-extractor, @stryker-mutator/core, and licensee -> @npmcli/arborist -> glob/map-workspaces) -- confirmed via `npm ls brace-expansion`. The DoS (quadratic-time / stack-exhaustion expansion) requires an attacker-controlled brace pattern reaching minimatch; every one of these call sites only ever matches this repository's own fixed, source-controlled glob patterns (Stryker's own mutate globs, api-extractor's own doc-model globs, crap4ts's own scan globs, arborist's own local dependency-tree walk) -- never a pattern derived from untrusted/external input.
exceptions.alternatives: No single version bump clears every path at once -- the four chains resolve independently (minimatch 9.x and 10.x, via different parents), so pinning would mean four separate overrides for tooling internals this package doesn't control the release cadence of.
exceptions.remediation: Revisit once crap4ts/api-extractor/Stryker/licensee each bump their own minimatch past the patched range.

exceptions.justification: Transitive via ajv (JSON Schema validator), pulled in by @microsoft/tsdoc-config and @stryker-mutator/core -- confirmed via `npm ls fast-uri`. Both only use ajv to validate their OWN static, local config-schema objects (typedoc/tsdoc config shape, Stryker's own config schema) at dev-tool startup. The vulnerability is an inconsistent host-case normalization in fast-uri's URI parsing that can make a security-relevant allowlist check admit a host it should reject; this package's own use of ajv here never parses or compares a URI at all (it validates plain config object shapes), let alone one derived from untrusted/attacker-supplied input, so the vulnerable code path is never exercised.
exceptions.alternatives: No fix available within either ajv's own current resolved range without an unverified major bump to ajv itself in two independent dev-dependency chains this package doesn't control.
exceptions.remediation: Revisit once @microsoft/tsdoc-config and @stryker-mutator/core each bump their own ajv past the patched fast-uri range.

exceptions.remediation: None available; revisit if a patched release ships.

exceptions.justification: Part of the same licensee -> @npmcli/arborist chain as the adjacent @npmcli/arborist/@sigstore/* exceptions in this file -- confirmed via `npm ls ip-address`: licensee -> arborist -> npm-registry-fetch -> make-fetch-happen -> @npmcli/agent -> socks-proxy-agent -> socks -> ip-address, i.e. SOCKS-proxy support for npm's own registry-fetch machinery. As those sibling entries already establish, this package's own licensee usage (`licensee --production --errors-only --ndjson`) only reads local node_modules license metadata already on disk and never reaches arborist's registry-fetch code path at all -- and even within that unreached path, ip-address's own vulnerable subnet-comparison/parse-diagnostic code only runs when a request is actually routed through a SOCKS proxy, which nothing in this repo's CI or local setup configures (no SOCKS proxy in .npmrc or environment).
exceptions.alternatives: Same as the adjacent @npmcli/arborist entry: an unverified licensee major downgrade.
